integrity: All formulae have self-contained analytic proofs; independent validation has not been performed. Standalone finite checker is illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: The identity concerns nonzero singular values of transfer iterates from common weighted Fourier Hilbert inputs to L2, not the ordinary eigenvalue spectrum or dynamical conjugacy. The full motivating preprint was not accessible and analogous historical transfer-operator statements remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Identical transfer singular spectra across expanding and contracting toral dynamics
